clues: This small town is in the south east of Jamaica, in the Caribbean. It sits at the mouth of the harbour of Kingston, the main city.
Big hurricanes are strong storms here. They hit this coast again and again, and they do much harm.
Men from Spain founded this town in 1494. At its peak, it was the largest and richest town in the Caribbean Sea.
Pirate crews from all round the world made this their base. Old tales call it the wickedest city on Earth.
In 1692, a huge quake and a great wave wrecked this town. The new town of Kingston then grew up close by and took its place.
